title: What Should an Agent Remember? Disentangling Retention from Retrieval in Bounded-Memory Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00366v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A persistent agent must decide both what to retain as information arrives and what to surface once a query appears, yet memory evaluations can confound these decisions by comparing methods that differ in both retention and selection. We build a streaming-recall benchmark crossing retention and selection rules and evaluate every condition on the same 300 seeded episodes. Holding access fixed, query-aware selection improves required-fact recall by 15.5 percentage points (95% CI: 12.8 to 18.2), whereas a mixed comparison that also changes history access reports a 68.7-point advantage, of which 53.2 points are attributable to access. Under bounded retention, query-aware, dense, and oracle selection reach the retention ceiling, and all 319 observed failures in the bounded recency condition are caused by eviction rather than ranking errors. translated_title: 智能体应该记住什么？在有界记忆评估中解耦保留与检索
translated_abstract: 一个持久化的智能体必须决定在信息到达时保留什么，以及在查询出现时呈现什么，然而现有的记忆评估往往通过比较在保留和选择两方面都不同的方法，从而混淆了这两类决策。我们构建了一个跨越保留规则与选择规则的流式召回基准，并在相同的300个种子回合上评估每种条件。在固定访问方式的情况下，查询感知选择将必需事实召回率提高了15.5个百分点（95%置信区间：12.8至18.2），而一个同时改变历史访问方式的混合比较则报告了68.7个点的优势，其中53.2个点可归因于访问方式的差异。在有界保留条件下，查询感知、密集和oracle选择均达到了保留上限，且在有界近期性条件下观察到的全部319次失败都是由条目淘汰而非排序错误造成的。随着目标信息退到足够久远的过去，召回率降至0%。在SQuAD上重复该评估（摘要截断于此）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个流式召回基准，首次将智能体记忆评估中的“保留决策”与“检索决策”解耦，发现查询感知选择仅带来15.5个百分点的真实提升，而混合比较所报告的68.7个百分点优势中有53.2个点实际上来自访问方式的差异，且有界记忆下的失败主要源于条目淘汰而非排序错误。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a streaming-recall benchmark that disentangles retention from retrieval in agent memory evaluation, showing that query-aware selection yields a genuine 15.5-point gain while 53.2 of the 68.7-point advantage reported by mixed comparisons stems from access differences, and that bounded-memory failures arise from eviction rather than ranking errors.
